answer: Sybil defense runs on a collateralized thread. An agent locks a bond before its first task, and each settlement appends a signed record to that thread, binding its payout address to an attested machine. A farmer cloning it into many wallets must post a separate bond per clone, since two threads cannot share one deposit, and reputation decays unless renewed. On proven fraud the slash burns the thread to its root and follows the comet tail of co-signatures, wiping each wallet that vouched for it. The honest operator keeps one oasis of staked capital; the attacker pays a sunk bond per clone.
